candidates.title: The Final Word
candidates.instruction: Treat every opinion you offer as a ruling and every continued discussion as an appeal.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Conditional Command
candidates.instruction: Project firm authority, then soften whenever the source of that authority might be questioned.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Gatekeeper
candidates.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Rightful Place
candidates.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Made You Ready
candidates.instruction: Treat another person’s competence as evidence of your teaching, influence, and continuing seniority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Quiet Veto
candidates.instruction: Remain pleasant and cooperative while behaving as though nothing can proceed without your private consent.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: We Started Equal
candidates.instruction: Use shared beginnings to erase present rank, titles, and attempts to place distance between you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: My Support, My Say
candidates.instruction: Treat every past favor as a continuing investment in your right to influence present decisions.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Trusted Deputy
candidates.instruction: Act as the reliable second-in-command, managing access and details while quietly shaping every decision.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Succession Race
candidates.instruction: Treat every success, mistake, and compliment as evidence in an ongoing contest over who should lead.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Indispensable Rival
candidates.instruction: Use another person’s judgment constantly while minimizing how much influence that dependence gives them.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Once Undermined
candidates.instruction: Treat every disagreement as a possible repeat of the moment your authority was previously weakened.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Power Looks Good
candidates.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Formerly Important
candidates.instruction: Carry the habits and expectations of a role that once made you important, even when the present no longer supports them.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Mistake from Gone
candidates.instruction: Treat every decision as a test of whether you still deserve your place.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Protection Has Terms
candidates.instruction: Treat safety, support, and reassurance as arrangements that require you to remain in control.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Chosen by Power
candidates.instruction: Seek the attention of whoever seems influential and treat that attention as proof that you belong.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Public Respect
candidates.instruction: Seek visible signs of respect and treat private appreciation as insufficient.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Chain of Command
candidates.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Power Vacuum
candidates.instruction: Treat any uncertainty about who is in charge as an emergency that must be resolved immediately.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Opportunity for Influence
candidates.instruction: Find a path to greater influence in every assignment, setback, or unexpected responsibility.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Who Can Authorize This?
candidates.instruction: Treat titles and speeches as secondary; focus on who can grant access, allocate resources, and create consequences.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Symbol of Office
candidates.instruction: Choose one symbol, privilege, or position and treat control of it as proof of legitimate authority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Invisible Hierarchy
candidates.instruction: Treat every interaction as evidence of an unseen hierarchy and keep identifying who truly outranks whom.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the strongest portable, holder-specific Power Games candidate for this required Stance subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Make Them Your Deputy
candidates.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Not Dismissed
candidates.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
candidates.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Secure the Endorsement
candidates.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Delegate Downward
candidates.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Find the Real Authority
candidates.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Build a Coalition
candidates.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Challenge by Proxy
candidates.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Use the Proper Title
candidates.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Declare Allegiance
candidates.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Obey Without Explanation
candidates.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Yield Control
candidates.instruction: Make someone surrender control of a decision, resource, or symbol of authority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Orders from the Shadows
candidates.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Not Up for Debate
candidates.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: For Stability’s Sake
candidates.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Name Your Backers
candidates.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Strategic Retreat
candidates.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Act Authorized
candidates.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Rank Everything
candidates.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: More Power, More Problems
candidates.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Gracious Command
candidates.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Access Has a Price
candidates.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Consensus Means Me
candidates.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
candidates.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest repeatable Power Games engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Acting Leader
candidates.instruction: Project certainty while continually checking whether your temporary authority is still being recognized.
candidates.rationale: A clear playable behavior, but Conditional Command creates a subtler dependence on legitimacy and is less likely to become simple status posing.

candidates.title: My Name Opened Doors
candidates.instruction: Treat another person’s access and opportunities as extensions of the influence you once used for them.
candidates.rationale: Strong patronage material, but it risks requiring more specific shared history than My Support, My Say.

candidates.title: No One Skips the Line
candidates.instruction: Treat every privilege as valid only when granted through the proper sequence of rank and permission.
candidates.rationale: Playable and precise, but its procedural emphasis may fit Rules, Rituals & Institutions better than this pack.

candidates.title: The Loyal Opposition
candidates.instruction: Offer essential support while preserving your identity as the one person willing to challenge authority.
candidates.rationale: A useful paired-exercise role, but it combines support and dissent more densely than the selected Indispensable Rival.

candidates.title: All Eyes Upward
candidates.instruction: Treat every group as naturally organizing itself around one unquestioned center of power.
candidates.rationale: Too abstract and less behaviorally specific than Invisible Hierarchy.

candidates.title: Respect Is Visible
candidates.instruction: Seek obvious public deference and dismiss every quieter form of appreciation.
candidates.rationale: Near-duplicates the selected Public Respect card without adding a distinct escalation pattern.

candidates.title: Born for Command
candidates.instruction: Behave as though leadership reveals your true nature and every lesser role is a temporary misunderstanding.
candidates.rationale: The premise is broad and grandiose but less emotionally layered than Formerly Important.

candidates.title: Everyone Needs a Sponsor
candidates.instruction: Treat proximity to influence as the only reliable proof that a person truly belongs.
candidates.rationale: The world claim is less holder-specific and less immediately playable than Chosen by Power.

candidates.title: Get It in Writing
candidates.instruction: Get formal proof that someone with authority approved your decision.
candidates.rationale: Clean and useful, but its procedural focus is better reserved for Rules, Rituals & Institutions.

candidates.title: Find the Weak Link
candidates.instruction: Probe for the person, promise, or dependency that makes another position vulnerable.
candidates.rationale: Strong leverage engine, but it is more adversarial and less broadly usable than Find the Real Authority.

candidates.title: Reward the Loyal
candidates.instruction: Offer small privileges until someone proves how far they will go to keep them.
candidates.rationale: A compelling patronage pattern that may become a distinct advanced card after live testing.

candidates.title: Let Them Think They Won
candidates.instruction: Frame every concession as bait that advances a larger plan only you understand.
candidates.rationale: Excellent veteran material, but it approaches the delayed-reveal territory reserved for Advanced Scene Engines.

candidates.title: Make Them Kneel
candidates.instruction: Force someone to perform a literal display of submission before you proceed.
candidates.rationale: Too literal, coercive, and setting-limiting compared with Yield Control.

candidates.title: Take the Credit
candidates.instruction: Make everyone agree that the successful outcome belongs primarily to you.
candidates.rationale: Too generic and too close to existing recognition objectives without a specifically power-centered method.

candidates.title: Overrule It
candidates.instruction: Replace another decision with your own and make the replacement final.
candidates.rationale: Clear but narrow; it offers fewer playable routes and escalation beats than Yield Control.

candidates.title: Keep the Throne Warm
candidates.instruction: Keep someone nearby until they publicly confirm your continued authority.
candidates.rationale: The throne language is unnecessarily setting-specific and the objective overlaps recognition more than retention.
